review.review: CMake only adds an EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL independent GPU contract target, with no default runner linkage or compiler option change. MtpDraftExtend retains argument/slot/position validation and existing cleanup ownership; only host-known uniform T>4 multi-slot prefill passes a compressed-key scoring slice. Pooled KV/index writes, slot offsets, mixed-slot and T<=4 dispatch remain intact. No field, route, whitelist, template, output-parser, scheduling, quota or cancellation implementation changes. Existing min-slot capacity bounds remain in force. BF16 GEMM replaces SIMT scoring arithmetic in this path; numerical/performance acceptance is separately pending, not certified by this inventory. Protocol source hash changes because src/mtp/mtp.cu is included; old packages and durable tasks stay pinned.
